intro.welcomeSub: One calm, private place to get life's important things organised, for you today, and for the people you love tomorrow.
intro.buildTitle: Build your plan, step by step.
intro.buildSub: Home shows your estate readiness. Follow “Up next” and watch your score grow as your plan takes shape.
intro.buildAccountsText: Banks, pensions and policies, one clear picture.
intro.buildVaultText: Wills, deeds and documents, encrypted and safe.
intro.accessSub: Invite the people you trust from the Family tab, each person gets exactly the access you choose.
intro.accessContactsText: Spouse, executors, advisers, each with their own role.
intro.accessTermsText: Share now, or only after you're gone. Nothing without your say-so.
intro.moreSub: Everything else lives under More, private and locked behind your passcode.
intro.moreMessagesText: Sealed letters for the people you love.
intro.moreAssistantText: Gentle help organising it all, whenever you ask.

resourcesScr.subtitle: Guides for every part of your plan
resourcesScr.g1b: Add each bank, pension, investment and insurance policy. Include the provider and the last four digits, never full numbers or passwords.
resourcesScr.g2b: Upload your will, property deeds, insurance policies and passports. Everstead keeps them encrypted and shares them only with the people you choose.
resourcesScr.g3b: Invite the people you trust (a partner, executor or solicitor) and choose exactly what each can see, and when.
resourcesScr.g4b: Write step-by-step notes for your family: what to do in the first 48 hours, who to contact, and where to find things.
resourcesScr.g5b: Record sealed letters or videos for the people you love, delivered when the time is right.
